sentences.note: The manifestation of greeting directed toward the addressee is the conventional salutation.
The predicate is the once-rotated event form, not the nominal base.
Clause-final ri changes assertion to a yes/no question.
va suppresses an explicit subject and addresses the listener.
mi locates the manifestation before speech time.
mu locates the manifestation after speech time.
sa negates the proposition, distinct from root-counteraction.
la marks the nominal as plural.

sentences.az: ta yu no lemiso ko niroke.
sentences.note: ko introduces an external causer while no marks the affected stone.

sentences.az: ta ya no lorasi mu ko rivoke.
sentences.ipa: /ta ja no loˈɾasi mu ko ɾiˈvoke ./
sentences.gloss: AGT 1SG PAT HOME.CONC FUT CAUS CREATION.EVT .
sentences.note: Tense precedes valency-changing causative.

sentences.az: ta ya li lorasi no kolasi ra.
sentences.ipa: /ta ja li loˈɾasi no koˈlasi ɾa ./
sentences.gloss: AGT 1SG GEN HOME.CONC PAT SHELTER.CONC EQU .
sentences.note: The genitive connector li binds possessor ya to head home; ra classifies the subject.
lo requires a plural actor and treats the participants as mutual counterparts.

sentences.az: ta ya no menito mi nu ko nitome.
sentences.ipa: /ta ja no meˈnito mi nu ko niˈtome ./
sentences.gloss: AGT 1SG PAT PROMISE.CONC PST PFV CAUS PROMISE.EVT .
sentences.note: nu conveys completion while mi places it in the past.
pa marks epistemic possibility, not future tense.
pe marks high speaker certainty.

sentences.az: ta ya di yu mi terona.
sentences.en: I closed the distance toward you.
sentences.note: Reversal of the syllable order is active counteraction, not ordinary negation.
ne marks an ongoing event; ke strengthens the event focus.

sentences.az: se ta ya nevaki si ta ya mu narimo.
sentences.ipa: /se ta ja neˈvaki si ta ja mu naˈɾimo ./
sentences.gloss: IF AGT 1SG DOUBT.EVT THEN AGT 1SG FUT INQUIRY.EVT .
sentences.en: If I doubt, I will inquire.
sentences.note: se and si delimit exactly one antecedent and consequent.
ra allows conceptual classification, not just personal identity.

sentences.az: ta nireta no kusuvu mi ko vusuku; ta larose mu notela.
sentences.ipa: /ta niˈɾeta no kuˈsuvu mi ko vuˈsuku ; ta laˈɾose mu noˈtela ./
sentences.gloss: AGT NIGHT.CONC PAT VOICE.CONC PST CAUS VOICE.CTR ; AGT STAR.CONC FUT HOPE.EVT .
sentences.en: Night silenced the voice; a star will kindle hope.
sentences.note: The two finite clauses contrast active silencing with an anticipated manifestation of hope.

method: Canonical root has 3 CV syllables with distinct consonants in ascending root-consonant order; S swaps the first two syllables; L rotates the result left by 0,1,2; s then r form unique states.
